'''Mell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], she also provided the knowledge of diplomacy to others.
